title: Official KB vs user_kb
summary: Ask reads only official qteasy_ai/kb. user_kb is a local scaffold for later research loops.
narrative:
Official knowledge lives in the qteasy-ai package (`qteasy_ai/kb/*.json`). Ask retrieves those pages only. A missing hit returns NOT_FOUND and does not call an LLM.

`user_kb/` under QTEASY_AI_HOME is created on first MemoryStore init: rules/, raw/{research,trades,factors,strategies}/, compiled/, plus an English README. Empty compile writes a valid empty catalog. Retrieval of user notes is not part of Ask in 1.0.
python_code:
from qteasy_ai.memory_store import MemoryStore
from qteasy_ai.knowledge_base import KnowledgeBase
store = MemoryStore()
print(store.user_kb_partitions_ok())
print([e.id for e in KnowledgeBase().retrieve('what is qteasy')])
risk_notes: Do not paste research notes into official kb/. Ask will ignore user_kb even if files exist.
